entities.summary: Gloria Twine Chisum is an experimental psychologist who eventually became a board member of the American Psychological Association, among many other organizations. An expert in visual problems associated with the operation of high-performance aircraft, she developed eyewear to protect pilots' eyes in extreme conditions like sharp turns, lightning, or nuclear explosion. Gloria Chisum was a physicians & medical pioneers from Muskogee (b. 1930, Muskogee). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
